readings.evidence: In the native tile at about x 2790–3000, y 3000, the letters read U-d-y-ā-n-a-tantra. There are no letters 'ḍḍāmara', so the inventory reading 'Uḍḍāmaratantra' is not supported by the visible strokes. The struck group before 'cudas' is two or three scribbled characters, possibly beginning '4' or 'H'. It remains illegible. The ending of the last word, '…kalpa', is clear, but its first syllables are doubtful.
The struck figure at about x 2990–3050, y 2690 has a heavy diagonal stroke through its second digit. The digit could be 3 or 5. The block anchor and the candidate record disagree on this digit.

readings.source_reading: A left-margin '{'-type bracket runs from e.125(3) to f.101, and a wavy line continues down to the page foot. A curved bracket in the title column runs from 'Parāśivamahimnastotra' down to 'Parārahasya'. In the right margin, an arrow runs from the f.101 line up to the e.125(3) line. No words are struck through.
readings.evidence: The marks are consistent with a transposition of the two lines, since Parārahasya would precede Parāśiva in sequence. A cancellation is not demonstrated, because the text of both entries is unstruck. The purpose of the wavy left-margin line is undetermined.

'Mahava' is clearly written, with no 'dh'. In the second line, the first figure before '+377' is malformed and could be 349. The figure '7' is followed by an overwritten colon or other mark. The zigzag line runs through both lines.
